_meta.name: AlmiOET localized-wording lexicon — v1 (beta-g)
_meta.purpose: The DATA that makes pages speak in the vocabulary locals actually search. Generator picks the local profession term, spelling, credential/exam name and search-intent phrasing per country. Same 'data-grounded generator' pipeline as the regulator dataset.
_meta.groundTruth: GSC Performance -> Queries filtered BY COUNTRY = the empirical localized wording people actually typed to reach AlmiOET. Pull that to extend/correct this lexicon. Secondary: Google autocomplete + Keyword Planner per locale.
_meta.scaleNote: This v1 covers OET's 12 professions x the main English-destination countries. The SAME structure extends network-wide: AlmiJob = role-name variants by country; AlmiStudy = subject/degree wording by country. Do NOT guess millions of terms — seed from this lexicon + GSC query data.
_meta.usage: For a {profession}x{country} page: term = professionTerms[profession].byCountry[cc] || .default; apply localeConventions[locale] spelling+vocab; name the local credential from credentialNames[cc][profession]; compose title/meta/H1 from searchIntentTemplates.

en-GB.notes: UK searches 'registration' + the regulator acronym (NMC, GMC, HCPC, GDC, GPhC).

en-IE.notes: IE searches the body: NMBI (nurses), Medical Council, CORU (allied health).

en-NZ.notes: NZ searches the Council: Nursing Council, MCNZ.

en-CA.notes: CA nursing uses NNAS + NCLEX; province colleges.

US.nursing: NCLEX-RN + state board of nursing (endorsement); CGFNS/TruMerit credential evaluation

searchIntentTemplates.note: Compose H1/title/meta/body from these; {profession} uses the localized term, {cc} the country.
byProfessionCountry: how to register as a {profession} in {country} (OET route)
searchIntentTemplates.originNote: High-volume localized long-tails combine destination + origin (e.g. 'register as a nurse in the UK from India'). Confirm real demand from GSC queries before mass-generating origin pages — gate them like any other.
